lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: the supplements I sent should have arrived.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Did you get them?
Yes, and I took some yesterday before I went to sleep.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: It's a supplement Pepper and I take regularly.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: They work wonders when you're having trouble sleeping.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Did it work for you?
It worked too well. I ended up oversleeping.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad it was so effective.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: They say good sleep is better than nearly any medication.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: It seems like sending you those vitamins really was the right move.
Vitamins?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, yes.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Actually, those special "supplements" that I sent you

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: are just ordinary over-the-shelf vitamins you can get in any store.
So that means...

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Yes, this was all a placebo effect.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You see,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: even fake medications can have a salubrious effect.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Of course, that's not to knock actual medication,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: but in cases where sleep deprivation is starting to have a significant impact on your mental faculties,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I've found this method to be the most effective in producing positive outcomes.
I see.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I'm glad to hear that you slept well.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If you ever find yourself in need of any similar supplements,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: just say the word, hehe.
